# Vendored

`color.cjs` is Color.js 0.7.1 (`colorjs.io` on npm), its `dist/color.cjs` with the source-map comment removed. MIT licence: `color.LICENSE`. The publisher loads it from here, so a project installs nothing to publish to Claude Design.

To update it, replace `color.cjs` and `color.LICENSE` from the new release's package, change the version above, and run the claude-design suites.
